classification.notes: Article describes a rule change by Long-Term Stock Exchange (LTSE) amending its Rule 11.280 on resumption of trading after a Level 3 market-wide circuit breaker halt. This is an internal exchange rule filing about trading resumption procedures, not an outside event that triggers any card's Step 1 scenario. It does not describe an actual market disruption, exchange halt, or declared emergency — only a procedural rule amendment about what happens after such a halt. No card in the catalog covers exchange rule amendments of this nature.
